**`app/javascript/readingTime/formatReadingTime.js`**
```js
export function formatReadingTime(minutes) {
  const rounded = Number.isFinite(minutes) ? Math.ceil(minutes) : 0;
  return `${Math.max(1, rounded)} min read`;
}
```
- Anything up to one minute (including 0 and negative numbers) returns `"1 min read"`. Anything above rounds up, so 1.01 gives `"2 min read"` and 2.5 gives `"3 min read"`.
- If the input isn't a usable number (`null`, `undefined`, `NaN` or `Infinity`), it returns `"1 min read"`. I added this because the current reading-time code also guards against a missing `reading_time`.
